summary.ranking_definition: CryptoSlam Ethereum all-time wash-filtered owner-to-owner sales in historical USD; duplicate contract aliases removed, higher total retained
headlines: 6 of the top 100 route metadata and every sampled declared media field fully on-chain (including the CryptoPunks data-contract special case).
6 have on-chain metadata and primary images; additional animation fields can still be off-chain.
49 depend on operator-controlled HTTP servers for sampled metadata or media.
49 use IPFS for sampled metadata or media; categories overlap.
13 have dead or degraded metadata/image delivery; 12 have at least one failed metadata sample.
53 have a live EOA-controlled URI, renderer, upgrade or artwork-data mutation path in the W6 audit; 52 can repoint delivery.

definitions.fully_onchain: W2 clean static metadata + ALL declared media test; CryptoPunks uses its separately sealed data renderer. This is a delivery-route test, not an inventory of every recovery contract.
definitions.liveness: W2 collection collapse of metadata and primary-image verdicts; all-declared-media status is separate.
definitions.metadata_failed: At least one sampled metadata target has repeated negative evidence, including reverting tokenURI; unknown excluded.
definitions.http_origin_dependency: Any ordinary HTTP metadata/media target; content-addressed IPFS/Arweave gateways excluded. This does not establish legal company ownership.
definitions.single_key_mutable: W6 eoa-mutable class for sampled NFT contracts and in-path dependencies. Does not include arbitrary web-server operators.
definitions.mutability_dates: Reused W6 results retain their analyzed_at; new audits use the same W6 analyzer. Pointer getter values refreshed separately.

caveats: Source-specific top 100, not an exhaustive global market census; rankings differ by USD/ETH, filters, coverage and project aggregation.
Small token samples do not prove collection-wide health, permanence or offline rendering.
Only two distinct IDs are indexed for 888 Inner Circle; three fungible units were checked.
Source-listed companion contracts with no sampleable NFT IDs are preserved as scope gaps.
Some Art Blocks and SuperRare source totals aggregate projects; a contract is not always one marketplace collection.
Alternate on-chain recovery contracts can exist even when the ordinary image URI is IPFS/HTTP (e.g. CyberBrokers).
